reported_symptom: High vibration alarm (RMS 6.8 mm/s) on Conveyor-1 Drive End bearing with high-pitched clicking.
actions_taken: Replaced damaged SKF 6205-2RSH/C3 bearing. Shaft journal micrometer check showed 24.992 mm (within tolerance). Heated replacement bearing to 110°C using induction heater and pressed flush. Charged with 15g Mobil Polyrex EM grease.
root_cause_summary: Pre-mature inner ring fatigue spall due to high dynamic tension shock loads on conveyor startup.

reported_symptom: Over-tight belt replaced earlier in shift caused DE bearing temperature spike to 82°C.
actions_taken: Loosened motor adjustment slide bolts. Measured belt tension using acoustic sonic meter (target: 65 Hz, found: 98 Hz). Re-tensioned to 64 Hz and locked jam nuts. Verified temperature dropped to 53°C within 30 min.
root_cause_summary: Improper belt tensioning technique without instrument verification during routine belt change.

reported_symptom: Dry screeching noise from Conveyor-1 tail/NDE end bearing during empty running.
actions_taken: Identified blocked grease nipple with hardened soap cake. Removed nipple, cleaned channel with brass wire and degreaser. Injected 12g fresh Mobil Polyrex EM. Screeching stopped immediately.
root_cause_summary: Grease nipple ball-check valve jammed with hard caked grease preventing automatic lubricator discharge.

reported_symptom: Heavy Slurry Pump DE cylindrical roller bearing displaying high BPFO harmonics and loud grinding.
actions_taken: Disassembled FAG NU 214 ECP bearing. Found severe stationary spalling on bottom 60° arc of outer raceway. Cleaned housing bore, verified concentricity, fitted new FAG NU 214 ECP and packed with 45g Shell Gadus S2 V220 2.
root_cause_summary: High cyclic radial reaction from heavy slurry hydraulic pulsations reaching end of L10 fatigue life.

reported_symptom: Crackling gravel sound and sharp high-frequency vibration bursts (2 kHz - 6 kHz) on pump DE housing.
actions_taken: Found suction valve partially throttled (60% open) due to loose handwheel worm gear. Opened suction valve to 100% and backwashed suction strainer basket. Cavitation noise vanished and vibration kurtosis returned to normal.
root_cause_summary: Hydraulic cavitation induced by suction valve throttling, transmitting severe shock waves into pump bearings.

reported_symptom: Axial thrust bearing overheating to 94°C with high axial vibration at 1X and BPFI.
actions_taken: Dismounted SKF 7314 BECBM paired angular contact bearings. Found impeller back balance hole clogged with dried slurry cake, causing massive unbalanced axial hydraulic force. Unclogged balance ports, replaced bearing pair and renewed mechanical seal.
root_cause_summary: Pump hydraulic balance line obstruction causing 4x design axial thrust overload onto paired bearings.

reported_symptom: ID Fan DE plummer block bearing exhibiting strong 1X RPM radial vibration (11.2 mm/s RMS) and foundation shaking.
actions_taken: Opened fan inspection door. Discovered 1.8 kg ash/tar buildup on underside of 4 fan impeller blades. High-pressure steam cleaned rotor blades. Performed dynamic two-plane balance test; added 45g correction weight on Plane 1. Overall vibration dropped from 11.2 mm/s to 1.4 mm/s.
root_cause_summary: Unbalanced ash deposition on fan impeller causing severe 1X rotating unbalance force on DE bearing.

reported_symptom: ID Fan DE spherical roller bearing inner ring spall detected via spectral envelope BPFI peak.
actions_taken: Replaced SKF 22218 EK bearing and H 318 adapter sleeve in SNL 518 housing. Measured clearance reduction with feeler gauge (initial 0.090 mm, final after drive-up 0.050 mm). Charged 75g Klüberquiet BQ 72-72.
root_cause_summary: Micro-spalling on inner raceway accelerated by past unbalance vibrations.

reported_symptom: Elevated plummer block housing temperature (91°C) with grease purging out of labyrinth seals.
actions_taken: Found housing completely packed with grease (approx 250g instead of 75g spec). Removed bottom purge plug and side drain covers. Ran fan for 45 min to discharge excess churning grease. Housing temperature dropped and stabilized at 68°C.
root_cause_summary: Over-lubrication by contractor technician during quarterly PM without opening grease drain port.

reported_symptom: Screw Air Compressor DE bearing generating high frequency electrical buzzing and kurtosis spikes up to 9.5.
actions_taken: Diagnosed VFD induced fluting erosion. Tested shaft voltage: 28V peak-to-peak. Displaced standard NSK 6310 C3 with SKF INSOCOAT electrically insulated bearing (VL0241 ceramic coated outer ring). Installed new Aegis PRO shaft grounding ring.
root_cause_summary: High-frequency PWM inverter common-mode current arching through thin oil film, causing micro-cratering fluting.

reported_symptom: Screw Air Compressor NDE angular contact bearing running with milky, foamy circulating oil.
actions_taken: Hydrotested oil cooler bundle; found pinhole leak on tube #4. Re-tubed cooler, flushed compressor lube system twice with flushing oil, changed full flow 10 micron filter, refilled with 40L ISO VG 46 synthetic compressor oil. Replaced NSK 7310 B bearing.
root_cause_summary: Cooler tube bundle corrosion leak allowing glycol cooling water to contaminate circulating lube oil.

reported_symptom: Raw Mill Pinion DE tapered roller bearing experiencing loud cyclic clunking and elevated 2X/GMF vibration.
actions_taken: Borescope inspection revealed fractured tip on pinion gear tooth #14. Replaced matched pinion-gear set and both Timken 32314 pinion support bearings. Checked tooth contact pattern with Prussian blue (achieved 85% flank contact). Flushed gearbox sump.
root_cause_summary: Shock overload during raw mill hard clinker blockage causing pinion tooth corner chip and impact transfer to bearing.

reported_symptom: Raw Mill Gearbox intermediate shaft bearing running hot (81°C) with prominent 2X RPM axial vibration.
actions_taken: Laser alignment check showed 0.28 mm angular misalignment between motor and gearbox input flange. Added 0.85 mm precision shims under gearbox front feet. Re-aligned to 0.03 mm offset and 0.02 mm/100mm angle. Axial vibration reduced by 78%.
root_cause_summary: Foundation settling of mill gearbox foundation pad causing severe angular misalignment.

reported_symptom: Cooling pump DE ball bearing exhibiting severe sandpaper rasping and water droplet stains around seal.
actions_taken: Replaced SKF 6308-2Z/C3 bearing. Found brown oxidized rust streaks on ball tracks caused by cooling tower spray drift. Fitted new SKF 6308-2RS1 (contact rubber seal) packed with water-resistant Mobilith SHC 100 and added rubber slinger disc over shaft.
root_cause_summary: Cooling tower drift mist penetrating non-contact metal shield (2Z), causing water corrosion pitting.

reported_symptom: Cooling water pump NDE bearing showing steady 1X/2X looseness harmonics and mechanical rattle.
actions_taken: Found two motor foundation hold-down anchor bolts loose (torqued <20 Nm). Inspected baseplate for soft-foot; corrected 0.12 mm soft-foot on rear right foot using stainless shims. Torqued all M16 grade 8.8 bolts to 175 Nm.
root_cause_summary: Foundation anchor bolt loosening under continuous water piping vibrations.
